error_control: One predeclared terminal prospective family: 5,000 paired event bootstrap draws for marginal intervals; approximate event-cluster influence t directional p-values; Holm 0.05 across eight claims per definition. No repeated evaluations, automatic promotion, or production-profit/fill guarantee.
support_interpretation: Definition and monitoring support gates are operational checks, not a power guarantee or permission to promote.

review_rules.continue: Freeze a new future definition; review both return measures, quote availability and dependence. Never reopen the old version.
review_rules.modify: Record an exact new definition and configuration diff; historical losing subgroups do not automatically become exclusions.
review_rules.stop: Record a human stopping rationale; actual external retirement requires separate evidence.
review_rules.inconclusive: Retain missing, conflicting or insufficient evidence without granting a pass.

evidence_reference: EXAMPLE ONLY: replace with your explicit policy review reference before recording

promotion.approval_reference: User approved prospective bounded-pilot review policy in Codex conversation 2026-11-02; pilot caps chosen at user request
